from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
smi = "C4(=C3C5C6CC7C8C6CC5C8C37)([C@H]2CCCC[C@H]24)"

best = energies.index(min(energies))

import numpy as np, collections
lines = open('answer.xyz').read().strip().split('\n')
